metadata.title: Riemannian Structures on Quotients in Elastic Diffeology via Q-Charts
metadata.abstract: Following Miyamoto, we consider Q-charts, a class of subductions $\phi\colon X\to Y$ of diffeological spaces along which Blohmann's elasticity descends. We show that the Riemannian apparatus of elastic diffeology---vertical, horizontal and full connections, Riemannian metrics, Levi-Civita connections and geodesics---also descends along Q-charts. More precisely, structures on $Y$ correspond bijectively to structures on $X$ that are invariant under the pseudogroup $\Psi(\phi)$ of fibre-preserving transitions, and torsion-freeness, effectivity, flatness, fullness, the Levi-Civita property and the geodesic equation are preserved in both directions. The key input is that the iterated tangent bundles $T^nX$ and their fibre products $T_kX$ are the pullbacks along $\phi$ of the corresponding bundles over $Y$. For quotients by principal actions of diffeologically discrete groups, we lift geodesics globally, prove that the class of elastic spaces on which $\R$ is a curve object is closed under such quotients, and show that complete geodesic flows descend. As an application, we determine the Riemannian geometry of the irrational tori $\Tor_\alpha=\R/(\Z+\alpha\Z)$ completely. Let $\vartheta$ be the one-form on $\Tor_\alpha$ induced by $dt$ on $\R$. Every Riemannian metric is a positive constant multiple of $\vartheta^2$, and the vertical connections form a one-parameter family of flat effective connections, a single member of which is the unique Levi-Civita connection of every metric. This connection has a complete geodesic flow, yet the induced pseudo-distance vanishes identically.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: elastic diffeology 商空间的黎曼下降
analysis.workSummary: 证明连接、度量、Levi–Civita 结构及测地线沿 Q-charts 对应于纤维过渡伪群不变结构；应用于离散群主作用商，并完整描述无理环面的度量和零伪距离。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展非传统光滑商中的黎曼结构工具。
analysis.limitations: 商需满足指定 Q-chart 或主作用条件；完整测地流不保证诱导伪距离为真正距离。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于语言编辑、检查证明以及讨论材料组织，所有数学结论经作者核验。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 ChatGPT 与 Claude 用于语言编辑、检查证明以及讨论材料组织，所有数学结论经作者核验。
